, Reason for Mistake: They accepted and followed the manager’s incorrect premise that the smallest county seat by land area was Colville and proceeded to compute the difference for Seattle and Colville without verifying the land-area criterion. Smaller county seats by land area (e.g., Waterville or Coupeville) exist, so using Colville led to solving the wrong pair and an incorrect final result.
